interval_selection.method: Nearest telemetry snapshots around pre-motion baseline and endpoint hold; motion onset/end were not hardware-marked.

operator_action.requested: Move aircraft forward approximately 20cm in 2-3s while keeping it level and near 20cm above textured desk; hold endpoint.

conclusion: Positive forward-weighted flow accumulation agrees with the established forward sign. The interval includes appreciable roll/pitch/yaw change and ToF varies 111-182mm; the physical displacement and exact motion boundaries were not independently measured. Do not update scale/rotation coefficients or infer lateral drift from this trial.
